GPTR-F-001-S122.title: Allowlist Schema Definition and Validation Contract
GPTR-F-001-S122.description: Define the canonical allowlist schema (collections, fields, operators, limits) and implement strict Pydantic validation models to enforce contract compliance for all incoming GPTReader requests.

GPTR-F-001-S123.title: Allowlist Configuration Loader
GPTR-F-001-S123.description: Implement a secure configuration loader that retrieves and initializes the allowlist definitions (collections, fields, constraints) at runtime, supporting environment-specific configurations without code changes.

GPTR-F-001-S124.title: Enforcement Audit Logging
GPTR-F-001-S124.description: Extend GPTReader to log all enforcement decisions ( թույլ/deny ) including rejected queries, violation reasons, and request metadata for auditability and security monitoring.

GPTR-F-001-S125.title: Standardized Error Response for Violations
GPTR-F-001-S125.description: Implement consistent, secure error responses for allowlist violations, ensuring no sensitive schema details are leaked while providing actionable feedback for debugging and SIT validation.
